name: iter
description: One product iteration skill: propose 2–3 concrete improvements, implement the selected scope, and evaluate with product data or authorized local scenarios.

interface.shortDescription: Choose an iteration, then deliver and validate its scope.
interface.longDescription: A single resumable product workflow for Agent Skills-compatible harnesses. Start with 2–3 concrete choices, reuse explicit authorization, and run isolated local scenarios when user feedback is unavailable. Separate local task success from real-user value.
defaultPrompt: Suggest 2–3 concrete improvements for this product, with scope, acceptance criteria, and risks, then let me choose.
Continue the saved product iteration within my approved scope; ask only when a material decision changes.
When user feedback is unavailable, propose isolated scenarios to test on my machine and state what the results can establish.
